svg.text: Check the actual entitlement and trial terms
Teaching diagram · not a screenshot or actual terminal result
Microsoft 365 admin/licensing pages and the AVD prerequisites link
Review Microsoft’s current eligible AVD licenses for each user and the matching Windows/hosting
rights. Verify your actual assigned subscription, qualifying OS requirements and expiry with
the license terms. A Defender-only user license does not provide Windows or AVD rights.
Business Premium is an example of an eligible bundle, not a mandatory purchase. An eligible
trial can be evaluated only under its actual terms. Annual advertised prices are commitments,
not a one-month lab price, and cloud resources may still bill during a license trial.
Verify a supported CLIENT endpoint protection entitlement for the Windows 11 host. Defender for
Servers Plan 1 covers server OSs; it does not turn that client host into a covered server. Do
not use external-user AVD pricing as a workaround for your own internal lab identity.
Check: Actual user and client-security entitlements, dates and allowed use are documented—or
